provenance.source: Decreto Legislativo 1/2010 de la Comunidad de Madrid, escala autonomica
provenance.notes: Scale reflects the deflated Madrid scale in force since 2024, carried forward to 2026. NOT verified against the current regional text. This file is the single place to correct it.

regionalDeductions.label: Deduccion por arrendamiento de vivienda habitual (menores de 35 anos)
regionalDeductions.help: Under 35, rent on your habitual residence, subject to the regional income limits and to the rent being at least 20% of your income. Tick eligibility only if you meet every condition.

inputSchema.label: I qualify for the Madrid rent deduction
inputSchema.help: Under 35, renting your habitual residence, within the regional income limits.

inputSchema.label: Rent paid during the year
inputSchema.help: Total rent on your habitual residence. The deduction is 30% of this, capped at 1.237,20 EUR.

omissions: Madrid childcare, birth, education and foster-care deductions are not modelled in v1.
